desc_completa_uso: RTM1-B zoning (RT50/0.40/3) — Low-Density Tourist Residential, Variant B. Well-suited to resort-style condos or villa clusters. It allows up to 50 lodging rooms per hectare (roughly 10 homes/ha), with Site Coverage (COS) 0.40 and Floor Area Ratio (CUS) from 0.30 (minimum) to 0.60 (maximum). Buildings may be up to 3 levels, with a 10 m height cap. A 4 m front setback applies, and rear/side setbacks follow the regulation alignments (“Var (a)”). Parking is required at 1 space per 3 lodging rooms (or alternatively, 1 per 180 m² of construction). Eligible lot sizes range from 500 m² to 10,000 m². All projects are subject to Complementary Standards A, B and C, plus any easements and lot-specific conditions.

RTM1-A zoning (RT20/0.25/2) — Low-Density Tourist Residential, Variant A. A great fit for boutique villas or low-key resort residences. It allows up to 20 lodging rooms per hectare (about 4 homes/ha), with Site Coverage (COS) 0.25 and Floor Area Ratio (CUS) ranging from 0.13 (minimum) to 0.25 (maximum). Buildings may be up to 2 levels, with a 12 m height cap. A 5 m front setback applies, and rear/side setbacks vary per the regulation alignments (“Var (a)”). Parking must be provided at 1 space per 3 lodging rooms (or alternatively, 1 per 180 m² of construction). Lot size is flexible (Var., no fixed minimum or maximum). All projects must comply with Complementary Standards A, B and C, plus any easements and lot-specific conditions.

TH1-B zoning (TH50/0.5/3) — Low-Density Hotel/Tourism, Variant B. Ideal for a boutique resort with breathing room. It allows up to 50 rooms per hectare (approximately 23 homes/ha equivalent), with Site Coverage (COS) 0.30 and Floor Area Ratio (CUS) from 0.25 (minimum) to 0.50 (maximum). Buildings may be up to 3 levels, with a maximum height of 16 m. Front/rear/side setbacks follow the regulation alignments (“Var (a)”), typically 5 m along primary roadways. Parking is required at 1 space per 5 rooms (for the first 20 rooms and for any additional rooms). Eligible lot sizes range from 5,000 m² to 200,000 m². All projects must comply with Complementary Standards A, B and C, plus any easements and lot-specific conditions.

TRC5 Tourist Residential Condominium zoning—designed for condo-style vacation living. It allows a maximum density of 10 units/ha, with Site Coverage (COS) 0.30 and Floor Area Ratio (CUS) 0.50. Up to 2 stories or 10 m in height are permitted. Setbacks are 5 m front, 5 m rear, and 2 m on each side. Parking is required at 1 space per 100 m² of construction. Uses are restricted to tourist condominium residences.

Low-Density Housing Cluster designation—excellent for a planned neighborhood or gated community. It allows up to 36 homes per hectare, with a maximum site footprint (coverage) of 60%. Total buildable area may reach up to 100% of the lot area (with vertical construction). Up to 3 levels are allowed, with an overall height cap of 11 m. Minimum open-space setbacks are 5 m at the front, 5 m at the rear, and 5 m on each side.

CU3 Urban Corridor zoning (Residential / Mixed-Use)—ideal for combining living with complementary commercial activity. It allows a gross density of 60 rooms/ha, with Site Coverage (COS) 0.80 and Floor Area Ratio (CUS) 1.40. There is no minimum ground-floor built area requirement, but lots must be at least 450 m² with 15 m of frontage. Up to 3 stories or 9 m in height are permitted. Setbacks are 5 m front and 3 m rear, with no side setback. Uses are limited to residential or mixed-use.
